$comment: Gate for scripts/eval-ai.ts --compare. maxDrop: a higher-is-better metric may fall by at most this much (absolute, rates are 0-1). maxRise: an error rate or a hallucination count may rise by at most this much. Referral recall and invented facts never get worse; the rest allow a little run-to-run noise. Tune here, not in code. research: routing is rule-based and deterministic, so it may not drop at all; a forbidden claim or an invented contact id is never acceptable; meanLookups, meanRounds and filteredRecommendations are reported for cost, not gated.
